nodes.label: ShellSmash Kame Knock Mini-Game Concept Art
nodes.description: Concept art for the Kame Knock mini-game (Arena: Dojo de Madera). Shows top-down wooden dojo arena with daruma/target objects. UI includes timer (00:45), score (12,750), score multiplier (x3), and controls (Apunta, Carga, Lanza, Impacta). Left panel lists all mini-games: Kame Knock (active), Turtle Targets, Bamboo Bash, River Rush, Sumo Survival (some locked, some coming soon). Right panel shows available turtles, Maestro Knock rank badge, rank score thresholds (1k/5k/10k/20k/25k), daily reward tracker (2/3), and turtle upgrade stats (Velocidad, Impacto, Puntería, Control) with special ability Rebote Encadenado. Global leaderboard: KameSensei 25,000; TurtleS 21,331; RoninDoki 20,115. Two gameplay view panes shown side by side.
